characters.gloss: Blob with antennae ending in balls.
A trash bin or signal box given a face, horns or legs.
Beaked creature, sometimes winged.
Generic soft rounded figure with dot limbs and no strong features.
A cactus standing like a person with raised arms.
The blue flying bear named in the Curious Bear lettering pieces.
A person on a bicycle, usually faceless.
Rounded winged creature with horns and a toothed tail.
A photographed person whose face or head is replaced by a flat cartoon shape. The signature move of the Scribble pictures.
A parked car evolved into a fish with fins and an eye, as in Scribble 29.
A creature at building scale, peeking over or sitting on rooftops.
Small figure with a striped sphere for a head, standing in Superland crowds.
A face drawn as a few hash strokes on a round head. The Superland signature.
Figure in a ringed space helmet, Superland.
A face or eyes tucked into foliage, clouds, hills or texture.
Rounded pod body with a pointed or hooded head and a small visor face. Appears in the 2011 town paintings, the 2016 airbrush sheets and the 2024 Scribbles.
Any rounded creature with one or two horns, usually white tipped.
Dinosaur like animal with a long neck, from the 2011 towns to the 2024 dinosaur bus.
The bear character of the 2009 Magicbear panels, red or blue with a square snout.
Blob or stalk body with a single large eye. The basic Superland and crowd citizen.
Domed creature with legs or bulbs, the Desertland resident.
Creature with tall rabbit ears.
Half closed or shut eyes, often with lashes.
A sun or sphere with a doodled face.
Wide open mouth full of white teeth; the crowd painting shouter.
Stacked faces forming a pole, in Superland and in Scribble 48.
The frontal symmetrical idol of the airbrush Totem series.
A car, bus or truck redrawn as a soft rounded cartoon, sometimes with eyes or fins.
A face reduced to a white rectangular visor or window.

style.gloss: Flat outlined cartoon shapes drawn over a photograph.
Scribble pictures where invented creatures populate the photograph.
The 2019 pastel oil paintings of desert pods and blobs.
Heavy outlined cartoon characters in the graffiti tradition.
Black ink line over or under sprayed colour.
Mountains, clouds or buildings added to a photograph that were not there.
The 2023 to 2024 series: a photograph with cartoon drawing over it.
So many small things that looking becomes searching.
Airbrush through cut stencils, leaving white gaps between cells.
The 2008 to 2009 oil paintings and their creature language.
The 2011 oil on wood paintings of towns and their residents.

themes.gloss: Invented creatures living in real places as if they belonged.
Pictures full of beings, with no empty space.
Signs, faces or brands blanked or scribbled out.
Landscape, buildings or objects that turn out to have faces.
Mountains, clouds or trees invented in a photograph.
Cactuses and trees that behave like beings.
One stencil or scene made in several palettes.
Cars and buses drawn as soft animals.

about: Controlled tags per facet, built from the first describing pass on 2026-10-04. Glosses are written for the recurring characters and the core style tags; others are self explanatory. Edit freely: scripts/validate.py reports any record tag that is not listed here.
